meta.description: Turns a shape around its midrib into a closed body, like a bud, a berry, a fruit, a capsule, a seed or a receptacle. It is placed like a leaf: it grows along -z from its base at the origin, at size 1 it is 100 long and as wide as the leaf of the same shape, so instance places and scales it like a leaf and set_color and deform work on it.

shape.description: The outline of one half of the body, from a shape node, like the outline of a leaf: x from the edge (0) to the axis (50), y from the tip (0) to the base (100). A point at x 50 closes the body there, the ends are closed in any case.

size.description: The scale of the body, at 1 it is 100 long. instance scales it again by the thickness of the path, like a leaf. Read along the body, alpha goes from the base (0) to the tip (1).

resolution_circle.description: How many segments the body has around, from the setting resolution.circle.
